newsitem.title: USA: Intek interim CEO to continue indefinitely.
newsitem.headline: Intek interim CEO to continue indefinitely.

text.p: Intek Diversified Crop said Tuesday its interim chief executive officer, Edmund Hough, has agreed to continue in that position for an indefinite period.
Hough, 52, is also a director of the company and of Securicor Group Plc, which owns a 62 percent stake in Intek.
"I am pleased to continue my role as CEO and to guide the company, as Intek represents an imporant investment for Securicor," he said.

In another development, Intek said that Robedrt Shiver, chief executive officer of Centennial Security Holdings Inc, has been elected director of the company. His election raises the number of the company's directors to seven.
